title: Looking Ahead: Con Miras A and Con Vistas A
goal: State a plan with con miras a and con vistas a, and use de modo que + subjunctive for a purpose with two subjects.
grammar: Purpose that looks ahead: con miras a, con vistas a

items: I can state a plan with con miras a and con vistas a + infinitive or noun.
